uncertainty: Unavailable: one exposed partly represented week. No confidence intervals/significance/power, multiplicity control or promotion inference. Retain all fixed methods and losses without ranking/selecting a winner.

primary.paired_population: For each fixed candidate and target, external numeric threshold rows with a supported actual and finite valid candidate, literal website, raw, recent and pooled points. All named control errors use those identical rows. Optional four-target692method never restricts any other method or target. Preserve all outer offers and exclusions.
primary.functional: Explicit classification heuristic sign(point-line), not a probability/median/conditional mean or a wagering decision.
primary.tie_rule: Literal numeric equality gives equal class. Point tie is not a calibrated probability of push.
primary.actual_push_rule: Actual equals recorded line -> statistical equal class, retained in primary. No venue settlement assumptions.
primary.delta: candidate misclassification minus website misclassification; negative lower error. Relative improvement100*(website_error-candidate_error)/website_error, zero denominator N/A.
primary.baseline_metrics: On each candidate-specific primary intersection also report raw, recent and pooled direction errors/point losses and signed differences; never compare scores from differing cohorts.

secondary: Separate candidate/SITE-only supported pairs and website-only scores retain their own exact denominators when raw/recent/pooled are unavailable; no transfer to primary.
MAE/RMSE/bias and absolute-error tails in each target units on the exact primary/common and secondary paired rows.
Nonpush direction error on all actual!=line rows, with point ties still counted wrong; point tie rate and actual push mass counts separately.
Per line source/role/team/opponent/player count and fallback/source/unknown-state coverage; public no IDs/row details.

Fixed within-phase line-source, role, team, opponent and literal-native-fallback subgroups via the same metric helper. Public only derived aggregates/player counts, no per-player rows or subgroup IDs.
protocol.source_wording: website-recorded provider-fed thresholds (590DraftKingsviaESPN,14SleeperPicks); code pipeline semantics verified, upstream raw quote body and publication timestamps unavailable.
protocol.cutoffs: Original board/receipt line and raw/SITE capture/generation clocks bound by hash and before kickoff. Reconstruction calculation clocks retained as after-game. Missing control source/cutoff clocks remain unverified and do not imply same-as-of evidence.
protocol.budget_accounting: The12configuration initial ladder cap and prior preclearedCDF/HGB search budgets are consumed. This packet reuses existing frozen outputs only: zero newmodelconfigurations/fits; bounded new measurement not a refund/restart of any training or score identity.
protocol.correction_policy: Original snapshot/point/outcome states remain immutable. New canonical clean-v2 source qualification separate; both finite contradictions/quarantines fail closed. Append attributable corrections under new version only, no rescore consumed ID.

source_and_evidence_limits: One exposed2026Week6. Category rows repeat player-games across statistics, methods and strata. The common-control and SITE natural-coverage counts are separately labelled; neither is a count of independent NFL observations. No new independent sample is created.

Thresholds are website-recorded provider-fed references: DraftKings via ESPN and Sleeper Picks. The original upstream quote body and publication timestamps are unavailable. This is not an authenticated raw sportsbook archive or a universal source-rights grant.

Original local threshold/raw/SITE capture clocks are distinct from postgame calculation clocks for reconstructed challengers. Missing clocks remain unknown. No contemporaneous, prospective or complete historical as-of claim follows.

This packet reuses frozen points only. Prior PFR-dependent fitted outputs are frozen comparators; no such features, model artifacts or training labels are read here. The original learner budgets, failures and source changes remain spent and exposed.

Numeric output is a three-way point-direction rule: under/equal/over relative to the literal threshold. Numeric threshold probabilities and proper probability scores are N/A; point directions are not calibrated probabilities.

Actual equality is reported separately. Nonpush accuracy is secondary and does not assume any market settlement, payout or return rule. No line, epsilon, threshold, weight, window or winner search is performed.

Each candidate's primary intersection includes its valid point plus literal SITE/raw/recent/pooled points and supported played actuals on the same offers. Candidate/SITE-only secondary pairs retain separate denominators. Optional692 coverage never shrinks unrelated method/target cohorts.

All156 method/target slots,288 comparisons and8998 declared group summaries remain, including zero/empty cells, six structurally missing numeric692 slots, and PPR/TD nonmarket blocks. No panel or method is selected by its result.

Differences below are arithmetic on already computed same-cohort aggregate rates/errors. They are not a new score pass, refit, model prediction, confidence interval or independent validation. Zero baseline denominators produce null relative improvements.

No intervals, significance, power, multiplicity claim, qualification, integration or promotion follows from one partly represented exposed week. DNP/unknown/missing/quarantined outcomes remain unscored and explicit.

bounds.conversion_semantics: One authoritative pre-outcome direction freeze plus at most one optional label-independent exact integrity recomputation; one frozen version and no point/direction changes. This cached-direction runner performs zero additional conversion calls and verifies reused fields exactly.
bounds.enforcement: One child run, CPU120s Unix hard limit, external300s/RSS1GiB guard,2threads; no automatic retry. Source/hash checks and shared metric code mandatory; no weakened checks.
bounds.arrow_threads: PyArrow CPU and IO pool caps2 each; all parquet reads use_threads=False. BLAS/OMP/MKL/NumExpr caps2 inherited; no unrestricted ArrowIO8 default.
